name: Omafly
author: Walid Rouibah & Dorneles
description: A small animated fly companion for the Omarchy desktop that wanders around and reacts to mouse movement and moving windows.

barWidget.description: Animated desktop fly companion that roams and reacts to your cursor and windows

schema.label: Fly Active
schema.description: Whether the fly is currently roaming your screen.

schema.label: Fly Size
schema.description: Visual size of the fly on screen.

schema.label: React to Cursor
schema.description: Fly occasionally approaches and interacts with the mouse pointer.

schema.label: React to Windows
schema.description: Fly is attracted to moving window tops and perches on borders.

schema.label: Startle on Click
schema.description: Fly zips away when you click near it.
